description: This file defines a Java class 'BuyDownFeeAmortizationBusinessStep' that implements the 'LoanCOBBusinessStep' interface. It performs buy-down fee amortization processing for loan objects as part of a batch or business process, including methods for executing the step and retrieving metadata about the step.

classes.name: BuyDownFeeAmortizationBusinessStep
classes.description: A Spring component implementing business logic to process buy-down fee amortization for loans within the Fineract system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the buy-down fee amortization process for the provided loan if the feature is enabled in the loan's product details.
